description: Compact LibraryOn preservation evidence. Editable content and deduplicated media are kept separately in src/ and public/uploads/. No HARs, screenshots or duplicate API response objects.
limitations: Template evidence is original rendered HTML and compiled assets, not original CMS/React source.
Templates retain source URLs; these bundles are not an offline mirror.
Third-party presentations/videos remain references unless separately downloaded.
Unlinked CMS content and unreferenced uploads may be absent.
